system.summary: Numeric nomenclator 1-499: letters with homophones, many syllables, some words; 318 frequent, used as a null. Not the Villeneuve -> Otter key of 1737 (targets/villeneuve1737).

prior_solution.where: Inventory FRAN_IR_057640 marks both pieces as not deciphered / not transcribed; no edition found (Vandal 1887 checked); the period decipherments of 9 and 29 Jul 1737 (same volume) were used as key source only.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout ordered and paid the reproduction (Archives nationales) and set the protocol; AI agents transcribed (blind passes, arbiter, gloss re-reading), built the key, measured and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Glossed letters of 9 and 29 Jul 1737 transcribed with their interlinear decipherment; the two undeciphered letters transcribed in two blind passes plus a blind arbiter.

Key K1 fitted on the training glosses (coordinate ascent on edit distance, hard-EM, manual curation), frozen; pre-registered held-out test on frames 0200-0202: 0.661 vs best of 200 controls 0.263, below the 0.85 bar (fail).
Both letters decoded with K2 (all glossed frames), frozen before decoding; counted by the rule of #728.

Blind sign sheet V on nine doubtful digits (three controls, 3 of 3), chosen by a rule with a written integration clause, hashed before the thumbnails (sign_check/sheet-V-rule.md). Brice Dudout answered; an AI model wrote the rule, cut the thumbnails, built the sheet and scored it. All nine targets confirmed the shape that makes the word. Sure words T1 106 -> 108 of 255, T2 348 -> 355 of 841 (0.415 -> 0.422).

validation.notes: Pre-registered held-out test on frames 0200-0202 (598 groups): 0.661, best of 200 shuffled-key controls 0.263; criterion >= 0.85 and >= control + 0.30 -> not met (absolute bar). Portion burnt; key not validated at the standard bar.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.fraction_read_source: rule of #728: 463 sure words of 1,096 cipher words (T1 108/255, T2 355/841; reading.md, count728_detail.txt), after the blind sign check of 23 Nov 2026 (106/255 and 348/838 before it); weak values, absent codes and gutter losses are holes.

credits.note: Reproduction ordered from the Archives nationales; key from the volume's period decipherments; two undeciphered letters read in part

gaps.detail: 234 target groups use codes absent from the glossed witnesses; 99 key values weak
